messages.subject: Project Tempest — Subscription Agreement v2 (redline)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver, Deepa,

As promised, attached is our v2 redline against your comments. The tracked changes show: founder cap reduced to £1.5m; de minimis to £35k; basket to £180k; general warranty limit extended to 24 months; and the Westbridge observer right expanded to include board papers (cl. 7.2). Everything else is as before. I think this should be close to final on the limitations.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
